mintAuthority.summary: XOFm's StableTokenV2 authorizes the Mento Broker and Validators addresses to mint. The token owner and proxy administrator are the Mento Timelock with an observed two-day delay; XOFm is reserve-backed, not the BorrowerOperations CDP liability. D14: issuance is economically unbounded because the token owner can set an arbitrary Broker/minter with no token-level collateral check; the two-day delay does not bound the amount. D29 is not certified because the authorized Validators proxy has separate Celo Governance upgrade authority.

controls.label: Mento Broker (XOFm minter)
controls.evidence: At Celo block 78937958, XOFm broker() returned this address. The verified StableTokenV2 onlyMinter modifier authorizes broker, validators, or exchange; mint(address,uint256) calls _mint without a token-level numeric ceiling. Broker swap constraints are a separate contract surface and are not represented as a USDm borrower-CDP cap.

controls.label: Celo Validators (XOFm authorized minter)
controls.evidence: At Celo block 78937958, XOFm validators() returned this address and exchange() was zero. StableTokenV2 explicitly includes validators in onlyMinter. This records the configured token-level authorization, not a verified external key threshold, operational issuance policy, or collateral cap.

controls.label: Mento Timelock (XOFm token owner)
controls.evidence: At Celo block 78937958, XOFm owner() and the EIP-1967 proxy admin slot both returned 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147. getMinDelay() returned 172800; hasRole(PROPOSER_ROLE, MentoGovernor 0x47036d78bb3169b4f5560dd77bf93f4412a59852) and hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE, zero address) returned true. Membership of these two accounts does not establish an exhaustive proposer inventory. The verified token owner can change broker, validators, and exchange; the proxy admin can replace mint-critical logic.

review.evidence: Re-reviewed at Celo block 78937958: XOFm resolves to StableTokenV2 implementation 0x434563b0604be100f04b7ae485bcafe3c9d8850e, with Mento Timelock 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147 as both owner and proxy administrator. The timelock delay is 172800 seconds, the named MentoGovernor has proposer membership, and execution is open. broker() and validators() identify the two configured nonzero onlyMinter paths; exchange() is zero. The prior BorrowerOperations control and USDm-CDP cap description belonged to a different liability and are removed. Mento's pinned backing configuration identifies XOFm as reserve-backed. The token owner can replace minter addresses and the proxy implementation; the reserve API remains an issuer-run holdings disclosure, not independent prudential supervision. D14/D29 review 2026-10-03 at Celo block 79142378 (hash 0xe5ac3917c420c5f097992356e3a8934c336d354a139b8a1207fe547af3569c6c): owner(), _getOwner(), and the EIP-1967 admin slot resolve to Mento Timelock 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147, not the migration Safe; the implementation slot resolves to verified StableTokenV2 0x434563b0604be100f04b7ae485bcafe3c9d8850e. Read-only setBroker(0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead) from that owner succeeds, and mint(chosenRecipient,1e18) from the configured Broker succeeds. Verified setBroker accepts an arbitrary address; onlyMinter gates mint by caller identity and imposes no collateral/deposit check or economic ceiling. The 172800-second Timelock delay does not make arbitrary minter authorization economically bounded. D29 screening confirms MentoGovernor proposer/canceller membership, open execution, Timelock administration, and no such Safe roles; the separately observed canceller 0xe6951c4176aab41097c6f5fe11e9c515b7108acd is not asserted to have mint power. The governor uses the verified lock-escrowed veMENTO contract. However validators() on this token resolves to 0xaeb865bca93ddc8f47b8e29f40c5399ce34d0c58, whose proxy owner is separate Celo Governance 0xd533ca259b330c7a88f74e000a3faea2d63b7972: independently replacing this token-authorized implementation is not rooted in MentoGovernor. Current Validators targets registry USDm, not this token; that observation does not close its independent upgrade path. Complete governor-only issuance closure is therefore not certified and no governedIssuance or complete executionScope is authored. This D14 verdict supersedes any earlier raiseable/partially-bounded economic inference; reconciliation and supervision are unchanged.
